description: This file defines a struct 'CachedMessage' that represents a cached queue message with various metadata fields, along with extension methods for comparing cached messages to tokens and stream IDs.

classes.name: CachedMessage
classes.description: A tightly packed struct containing metadata for a stream queue message, including stream ID, sequence number, event index, enqueue/dequeue timestamps, and data segment.

classes.name: CachedMessageExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for comparing CachedMessage instances with stream tokens and stream IDs.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Compares the cached message to a stream sequence token to determine relative ordering based on sequence number and event index.

methods.name: CompareStreamId
methods.description: Checks if the cached message's stream ID matches the provided stream ID.
